During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], alongside the native [[Sessehshellah]], '''sabotaged''' an [[Imperial hydrocarbon refinery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. After [[Sabotage of an Imperial power station|sabotaging]] an [[Imperial power station]] on the planet, and capturing a [[comm unit scrambler]], the Alliance and Sessehshellah learned that the [[hydrocarbon]] operation on Shaymore had to increase production ten-fold within the following year or be shut down. In addition, the reserves held at the refinery were a significant portion of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] supplies.<ref name="Bright Water" />

{{RPGseed}}
The Alliance team and [[Sessehshellah]] approached the facility by [[raft]], allowing members of the team dressed as Imperial troops to charge across the [[Boat/Legends|boat]] dock and bluff their way past the guards. While this was happening, the Sessehshellah dove into the drainage ditches to plant [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] on the drainage valves for the storage tanks. During the battle, the Alliance operatives appeared to be cut off until rescued by a large number of Sessehshellah storming the compound and attacking the Imperial forces.<ref name="Bright Water" />

The Alliance and Sessehshellah forces fought their way to the boat dock and commandeered a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. As they sped away from the facility, it exploded as the demoliton charges were detonated. Imperial forces gave chase in armored [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], forcing the Alliance and Sessehshellah forces to abandoned their craft in the marshes. Imperial forces called in reinforcements, which arrived by [[landcruiser]], only to be ambushed in the marshes by the Alliance and Sessehshellah.<ref name="Bright Water" />
{{Endgame}}

With the refinery destroyed, the Empire abandoned its hydrocarbon operations on the planet, with the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] being recalled in disgrace. The Sessehshellah regained control of their world in the aftermath.<ref name="Bright Water" />
